motifs.name: distant_misty_mountain_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain chain and low shoreline stretching from the far left across the center, including the soft receding peaks, faint horizontal waterline, and sparse dotted tree belt below the hills. Exclude the boats, central pavilions, and right rocky massif.
must_preserve: thin grey contour lines defining the low peaks
soft diluted ink washes fading into the blank sky
broken horizontal shoreline strokes
tiny green-grey tree dabs along the shore
misty gaps and feathered wash edges

motifs.name: left_lake_sailboats

must_preserve: dark angular hull linework
slender vertical masts
triangular pale sail shapes with ink outlines
short broken water-ripple strokes around the boats
spacing between the separate boats

must_preserve: layered rock contours and angular crag outlines
dry-brush texture strokes on the slopes

must_preserve: stacked black roof eaves with upturned tips
fine architectural linework and vertical posts
